title: 真实 Streams 不兼容状态格式迁移：独立回放、业务对账切换与原状态回滚
body:
## 环境与初始材料
Kafka/Streams4.0.0、RocksDB9.7.3、JDK17真实编译、confluent-kafka2.10.1；工作区自启隔离RF1 broker与两个Java应用。无外部服务/宿主socket，2GiB/2CPU/PID768分布式档。

## 操作任务
实现 deploy_shadow(c,plan) 与 rollback(c,proof)。初始材料含真实旧Long二进制store与新decimal-String store两份Java拓扑，固定显式store名称totals但序列化不兼容。旧应用持续服务且原changelog必须保留；新应用使用独立application.id与独立state目录从完整权威源回放。审批、权威、ID/schema/源码hash、原changelog UUID和真实源low/high范围不符均拒绝且不变更现有路由。新应用在20秒内追平给定source点并与业务权威alpha/beta逐键相等、原生提交位点追平后，原子发布shadow.ready_path与c.route_path实际HTTP查询路由，再返回old_application_id/shadow_application_id/old_changelog_topic_id/new_changelog_topic_id/business_state/source_point/cutover/old_topology/new_topology/internal_topics（原生Topology.describe文本及真实内部topic清单）。失败停止候选、保持旧路由。rollback验证原state身份和旧应用可用，再先切回旧HTTP路由、后停新应用，返回application_id/changelog_topic_id/rolled_back。不得复用旧appid硬读不兼容格式，不删原内部topic或reset原组。

## 提交产物
solution.py；由程序发布被HTTP端点实际读取的ready和route产物。

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；动态真实native输入/状态格式/内部topic身份与位点、HTTP切换、失败回滚、独立错误反例；120秒内完成，环境错误不记题目有效拒绝。

## 能力边界
真实Kafka/Streams4.0.0、RocksDB9.7.3、JDK17；单RF1 broker、单分区源，两种实质不同存储编码，真实独立changelog+source位点回放、HTTP切换和回滚、新事件对账。2GiB/2CPU/PID768。本实验对已知拓扑与明确保留完整源的情况执行影子重建；不宣称任意版本/多分区全局快照/生产并发写切换的自动迁移，未核实权威范围必须拒绝。
review_note: Kafka批次4：真实Streams不兼容状态编码、隔离回放、业务HTTP切换与原状态回滚；完整平台四路及语义反例证据随批交付。
rubric: 交付物和验收对应题述数据边界
失败时不掩盖遗漏或未知结果

"""Private grader fixture: genuine self-contained Kafka 4 KRaft, loopback only."""
import os
import pathlib
import signal
import socket
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time
import uuid
from contextlib import contextmanager

from confluent_kafka import Consumer, KafkaException, Producer, TopicPartition
from confluent_kafka.admin import AdminClient, NewTopic


def port():
    with socket.socket() as sock:
        sock.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0))
        return sock.getsockname()[1]


@contextmanager
def broker(sasl=False,expose=False):
    """Own only this Java process group; never access Docker or external services."""
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='opsforge-kafka-') as directory:
        root = pathlib.Path(directory)
        client_port, controller_port = port(), port()
        while controller_port == client_port:
            controller_port = port()
        bootstrap = f'127.0.0.1:{client_port}'
        config = root / 'server.properties'
        config.write_text('\n'.join([
            'process.roles=broker,controller', 'node.id=1',
            f'controller.quorum.bootstrap.servers=127.0.0.1:{controller_port}',
            f'listeners=PLAINTEXT://{bootstrap},CONTROLLER://127.0.0.1:{controller_port}',
            f'advertised.listeners=PLAINTEXT://{bootstrap}',
            'listener.security.protocol.map=PLAINTEXT:PLAINTEXT,CONTROLLER:PLAINTEXT',
            'controller.listener.names=CONTROLLER', 'inter.broker.listener.name=PLAINTEXT',
            f'log.dirs={root}/data', 'num.partitions=3',
            'offsets.topic.replication.factor=1', 'offsets.topic.num.partitions=1',
            'transaction.state.log.replication.factor=1', 'transaction.state.log.min.isr=1',
            'transaction.state.log.num.partitions=1', 'group.initial.rebalance.delay.ms=0', 'group.min.session.timeout.ms=500',
            'auto.create.topics.enable=false', 'log.segment.bytes=10485760',
            'num.network.threads=2', 'num.io.threads=2',
        ]) + '\n')
        if sasl:
            content=config.read_text()
            content=content.replace('PLAINTEXT://','CLIENT://').replace('PLAINTEXT:PLAINTEXT,CONTROLLER:PLAINTEXT','CLIENT:SASL_PLAINTEXT,CONTROLLER:PLAINTEXT').replace('inter.broker.listener.name=PLAINTEXT','inter.broker.listener.name=CLIENT')
            content+='sasl.enabled.mechanisms=PLAIN\nsasl.mechanism.inter.broker.protocol=PLAIN\n'
            content+='listener.name.client.plain.sasl.jaas.config=org.apache.kafka.common.security.plain.PlainLoginModule required username="admin" password="admin-secret" user_admin="admin-secret" user_old="old-secret" user_new="new-secret" user_intruder="intruder-secret";\n'
            content+='authorizer.class.name=org.apache.kafka.metadata.authorizer.StandardAuthorizer\nsuper.users=User:admin;User:ANONYMOUS\n'
            config.write_text(content)
        env = dict(os.environ, KAFKA_HEAP_OPTS='-Xms128m -Xmx384m', LOG_DIR=str(root / 'logs'))
        # JAVA_HOME is supplied by the deliverable image (glibc JDK17+).
        storage = ['/opt/kafka/bin/kafka-storage.sh', 'format', '--standalone',
                   '-t', uuid.uuid4().hex[:22], '-c', str(config)]
        formatted = subprocess.run(storage, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20)
        assert formatted.returncode == 0, formatted.stderr + formatted.stdout
        log = open(root / 'broker.log', 'w+')
        proc = subprocess.Popen(['/opt/kafka/bin/kafka-server-start.sh', str(config)],
                                env=env, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                                start_new_session=True)
        try:
            deadline = time.monotonic() + 35
            admin = AdminClient(dict(auth(bootstrap,'admin') if sasl else {'bootstrap.servers':bootstrap}, **{'socket.timeout.ms':1000}))
            ready = False
            while time.monotonic() < deadline:
                if proc.poll() is not None:
                    break
                try:
                    if admin.list_topics(timeout=1).brokers:
                        ready = True
                        break
                except KafkaException:
                    time.sleep(.2)
            if not ready:
                log.flush(); log.seek(0)
                raise AssertionError('self-started Kafka readiness failed: ' + log.read()[-9000:])
            def restart():
                nonlocal proc
                if proc.poll() is None:
                    os.killpg(proc.pid,signal.SIGTERM)
                    try:proc.wait(timeout=8)
                    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:os.killpg(proc.pid,signal.SIGKILL);proc.wait(timeout=3)
                proc=subprocess.Popen(['/opt/kafka/bin/kafka-server-start.sh',str(config)],env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,start_new_session=True)
                import struct
                deadline=time.monotonic()+30
                while time.monotonic()<deadline:
                    if proc.poll() is not None:break
                    try:
                        host,port_number=bootstrap.split(':')
                        with socket.create_connection((host,int(port_number)),timeout=.5) as channel:
                            payload=struct.pack('>hhih',18,0,42,4)+b'test'
                            channel.sendall(struct.pack('>i',len(payload))+payload)
                            size=channel.recv(4)
                            if len(size)==4:
                                response=channel.recv(struct.unpack('>i',size)[0])
                                if len(response)>=6 and struct.unpack('>i',response[:4])[0]==42:return
                    except OSError:time.sleep(.2)
                raise AssertionError('NATIVE_ENVIRONMENT_ERROR: restart not ready')
            print('NATIVE_KAFKA_READY',flush=True)
            yield {'bootstrap':bootstrap,'config':config,'restart':restart} if expose else bootstrap
        finally:
            if proc.poll() is None:
                os.killpg(proc.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
                try:
                    proc.wait(timeout=8)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                    os.killpg(proc.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
                    proc.wait(timeout=3)
            log.close()


def topic(bootstrap, name, partitions=1, config=None):
    admin = AdminClient({'log_level':0,'bootstrap.servers': bootstrap})
    admin.create_topics([NewTopic(name, partitions, 1, config=config or {})])[name].result(10)


def produce(producer, name, values, partition=0, expected_error=None):
    errors = []
    for value in values:
        producer.produce(name, value, partition=partition,
                         on_delivery=lambda err, message: errors.append(err))
    assert producer.flush(10) == 0
    assert len(errors) == len(values), errors
    if expected_error is None:
        assert all(error is None for error in errors), errors
    else:
        assert all(error and error.code() == expected_error for error in errors), errors


def consumer(bootstrap, group=None, isolation='read_committed'):
    return Consumer({'log_level':0,'bootstrap.servers': bootstrap, 'group.id': group or uuid.uuid4().hex,
                     'enable.auto.commit': False, 'isolation.level': isolation,
                     'enable.partition.eof': True, 'auto.offset.reset': 'earliest',
                     'fetch.wait.max.ms': 50})


def read(bootstrap, name, isolation='read_committed', seconds=2):
    client = consumer(bootstrap, isolation=isolation)
    values = []
    try:
        client.assign([TopicPartition(name, 0, 0)])
        deadline = time.monotonic() + seconds
        while time.monotonic() < deadline:
            message = client.poll(.1)
            if message is not None and not message.error():
                values.append(message.value())
        return values
    finally:
        client.close()


def tx(bootstrap, transaction_id):
    producer = Producer({'log_level':0,'bootstrap.servers': bootstrap, 'transactional.id': transaction_id,
                         'transaction.timeout.ms': 30000, 'message.timeout.ms': 10000})
    producer.init_transactions(15)
    return producer


def auth(bootstrap,user):
    return {'log_level':0,'bootstrap.servers':bootstrap,'security.protocol':'SASL_PLAINTEXT','sasl.mechanism':'PLAIN','sasl.username':user,'sasl.password':user+'-secret','socket.timeout.ms':5000}


def next_message(client,seconds=8):
    deadline=time.monotonic()+seconds
    while time.monotonic()<deadline:
        message=client.poll(.1)
        if message is not None:
            if not message.error():return message
            if message.error().code()!=-191:raise KafkaException(message.error())
    raise AssertionError('expected real Kafka message before deadline')


def committed(bootstrap,name,group,partition=0):
    c=consumer(bootstrap,group)
    try:return c.committed([TopicPartition(name,partition)],timeout=8)[0].offset
    finally:c.close()


def join(client,topic_name,seconds=12):
    client.subscribe([topic_name])
    deadline=time.monotonic()+seconds
    while time.monotonic()<deadline:
        client.poll(.05)
        if client.assignment():return client.assignment()
    raise AssertionError('real group assignment not received')

title: 真实 Streams 事件时间 JOIN：grace、重复事件与迟到补偿审计
body:
## 环境与初始材料
Kafka/Streams4.0.0、RocksDB9.7.3、JDK17真实编译、confluent-kafka2.10.1；工作区自启隔离RF1 broker与一个Java窗口JOIN应用。无外部服务/宿主socket，2GiB/2CPU/PID768分布式档。

## 操作任务
提交JoinLogic.java的wire(builder,orders,payments,output)原生KafkaStreams leftJoin拓扑：对称事件时间窗口1000ms，grace500ms，String key/value，输出orderPayload|paymentPayload或NONE。不能用墙钟结案，必须延迟未匹配输出到stream-time关闭窗口；支持payment先到、grace内乱序和业务重复。另实现solution.py reconcile(path,joined,late,policy,fail_after_write=False)，对真实native JOIN输出及真实late source位点做SQLite事务幂等审计。audit(event_id,order_id,kind,fingerprint,source_meta)、states(order_id,status,payment_id)、outbox(order_id,payment_id,status)三表；MATCHED、UNMATCHED_AS_OF_WINDOW仅为截至水位的历史结果；grace外迟到只进入LATE_PAYMENT_REVIEW并排一条REVIEW_REQUIRED补偿审查，不自动宣称支付失败/成功。按kind/order/payment业务ID去重，内容冲突拒绝；保留原始topic/partition/offset/timestamp和历史未匹配审计。策略须明确window1000/grace500/窗口状态逻辑retention2500且unmatched_is_final=False；拒绝无限期或终局未匹配承诺。真实SQL写后故障须回滚，重复回放无重复outbox。返回audit计数、states字典、outbox计数。

## 提交产物
solution.py、JoinLogic.java；真实业务SQLite审计与待审队列。

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；动态真实native输入/状态格式/内部topic身份与位点、事件时间grace、幂等审计与事务回滚、独立错误反例；120秒内完成，环境错误不记题目有效拒绝。

## 能力边界
真实Java KafkaStreams4/RocksDB单RF1 broker、双源各单分区，实际native JOIN输出与原始Kafka晚到记录读回；真实SQLite事务/幂等业务审查队列。没有Python模拟JOIN；grace外未回改只据实际输出判断，不虚报task dropped-records计数（初探该指标为0）。补偿仅为本地待审队列，不执行外部支付/撤销。2500ms是窗口+grace逻辑状态期限，不声称Kafka内部changelog物理保留或生产峰值资源精确等于它；不覆盖多分区空闲水位/跨机时钟/生产容量保证。

失败时不掩盖遗漏或未知结果

import pathlib,sys,json,time,uuid,os
sys.path[:0]=[str(pathlib.Path.cwd()),str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/"checks")]
import solution as task
from native import *
import inspect,functools
def _trace_operation(name,function):
    @functools.wraps(function)
    def invoke(*args,**kwargs):
        print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:'+name,flush=True)
        try:result=function(*args,**kwargs)
        except BaseException:
            print('STUDENT_OPERATION_RAISED:'+name,flush=True)
            raise
        print('STUDENT_OPERATION_RETURNED:'+name,flush=True)
        return result
    return invoke
for _name,_function in list(vars(task).items()):
    if not _name.startswith('_') and inspect.isfunction(_function) and _function.__module__=='solution':setattr(task,_name,_trace_operation(_name,_function))
import tempfile,sqlite3,copy
from join_native import JoinSession

def database(path):
    connection=sqlite3.connect(path)
    try:return {name:connection.execute('SELECT * FROM '+name+' ORDER BY 1').fetchall() for name in ['audit','states','outbox']}
    finally:connection.close()
with broker() as bootstrap,tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='owned-join-grader-') as directory:
    orders,payments,output=[kind+'-'+uuid.uuid4().hex for kind in ['orders','payments','output']]
    for name in [orders,payments,output]:topic(bootstrap,name)
    s=JoinSession(bootstrap,directory,orders,payments,output)
    try:
        a,b,c=['order-'+uuid.uuid4().hex for _ in range(3)];pa,pb,pc=[uuid.uuid4().hex for _ in range(3)]
        for _ in range(2):s.emit('payments',a,'payment:'+pa,10000)
        s.emit('orders',a,'order:'+a,10300)
        s.collect(15,lambda row:row['key']==a and row['value']=='order:'+a+'|payment:'+pa)
        s.collect(.5)
        assert sum(row['key']==a and row['value']=='order:'+a+'|payment:'+pa for row in s.seen)==2,'duplicate native payment event not exercised'
        s.emit('orders',b,'order:'+b,11000);s.collect(.5)
        assert not any(row['key']==b for row in s.seen),'wallclock caused early unmatched close'
        for kind in ['orders','payments']:s.emit(kind,'CTRL_1','control',20000)
        s.collect(8,lambda row:row['key']==b and row['value']=='order:'+b+'|NONE')
        s.emit('orders',c,'order:'+c,21000)
        for kind in ['orders','payments']:s.emit(kind,'CTRL_2','control',22300)
        s.collect(1.3)
        # Kafka Streams buffers unmatched emissions and checks its real emit throttle
        # when processing records. A second native control event at the same
        # stream-time forces that check; sleeping alone must not be the test.
        for kind in ['orders','payments']:s.emit(kind,'CTRL_2_RECHECK','control',22300)
        s.collect(.4)
        assert not any(row['key']==c and row['value'].endswith('|NONE') for row in s.seen),'grace window incorrectly discarded'
        s.emit('payments',c,'payment:'+pc,21500)
        s.collect(8,lambda row:row['key']==c and row['value']=='order:'+c+'|payment:'+pc)
        for kind in ['orders','payments']:s.emit(kind,'CTRL_3','control',26000)
        produced=s.emit('payments',b,'payment:'+pb,11500);s.collect(.8)
        assert not any(row['key']==b and not row['value'].endswith('|NONE') for row in s.seen),'closed native join unexpectedly backfilled'
        late=s.source_record(bootstrap,'payments',produced['offset']);assert late==produced,'late audit is not actual native source record'
        late['observed_stream_time']=26000
        joined=[record for record in s.seen if not record['key'].startswith('CTRL_')]
        assert sum(record['key']==a for record in joined)==2 and sum(record['key']==b for record in joined)==1 and sum(record['key']==c for record in joined)==1
        policy={'window_ms':1000,'grace_ms':500,'max_retention_ms':2500,'unmatched_is_final':False}
        path=pathlib.Path(directory)/'business.sqlite3'
        for change in [{'unmatched_is_final':True},{'max_retention_ms':-1},{'grace_ms':0}]:
            try:task.reconcile(path,joined,[],{**policy,**change})
            except ValueError:pass
            else:raise AssertionError('unbounded or terminal-unmatched policy accepted')
        result=task.reconcile(path,joined,[],policy)
        assert result['states']=={a:'MATCHED',b:'UNMATCHED_AS_OF_WINDOW',c:'MATCHED'} and result['audit']==3 and result['outbox']==0,result

"""Private grader fixture: genuine self-contained Kafka 4 KRaft, loopback only."""
import os
import pathlib
import signal
import socket
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time
import uuid
from contextlib import contextmanager

from confluent_kafka import Consumer, KafkaException, Producer, TopicPartition
from confluent_kafka.admin import AdminClient, NewTopic


def port():
    with socket.socket() as sock:
        sock.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0))
        return sock.getsockname()[1]


@contextmanager
def broker(sasl=False,expose=False):
    """Own only this Java process group; never access Docker or external services."""
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='opsforge-kafka-') as directory:
        root = pathlib.Path(directory)
        client_port, controller_port = port(), port()
        while controller_port == client_port:
            controller_port = port()
        bootstrap = f'127.0.0.1:{client_port}'
        config = root / 'server.properties'
        config.write_text('\n'.join([
            'process.roles=broker,controller', 'node.id=1',
            f'controller.quorum.bootstrap.servers=127.0.0.1:{controller_port}',
            f'listeners=PLAINTEXT://{bootstrap},CONTROLLER://127.0.0.1:{controller_port}',
            f'advertised.listeners=PLAINTEXT://{bootstrap}',
            'listener.security.protocol.map=PLAINTEXT:PLAINTEXT,CONTROLLER:PLAINTEXT',
            'controller.listener.names=CONTROLLER', 'inter.broker.listener.name=PLAINTEXT',
            f'log.dirs={root}/data', 'num.partitions=3',
            'offsets.topic.replication.factor=1', 'offsets.topic.num.partitions=1',
            'transaction.state.log.replication.factor=1', 'transaction.state.log.min.isr=1',
            'transaction.state.log.num.partitions=1', 'group.initial.rebalance.delay.ms=0', 'group.min.session.timeout.ms=500',
            'auto.create.topics.enable=false', 'log.segment.bytes=10485760',
            'num.network.threads=2', 'num.io.threads=2',
        ]) + '\n')
        if sasl:
            content=config.read_text()
            content=content.replace('PLAINTEXT://','CLIENT://').replace('PLAINTEXT:PLAINTEXT,CONTROLLER:PLAINTEXT','CLIENT:SASL_PLAINTEXT,CONTROLLER:PLAINTEXT').replace('inter.broker.listener.name=PLAINTEXT','inter.broker.listener.name=CLIENT')
            content+='sasl.enabled.mechanisms=PLAIN\nsasl.mechanism.inter.broker.protocol=PLAIN\n'
            content+='listener.name.client.plain.sasl.jaas.config=org.apache.kafka.common.security.plain.PlainLoginModule required username="admin" password="admin-secret" user_admin="admin-secret" user_old="old-secret" user_new="new-secret" user_intruder="intruder-secret";\n'
            content+='authorizer.class.name=org.apache.kafka.metadata.authorizer.StandardAuthorizer\nsuper.users=User:admin;User:ANONYMOUS\n'
            config.write_text(content)
        env = dict(os.environ, KAFKA_HEAP_OPTS='-Xms128m -Xmx384m', LOG_DIR=str(root / 'logs'))
        # JAVA_HOME is supplied by the deliverable image (glibc JDK17+).
        storage = ['/opt/kafka/bin/kafka-storage.sh', 'format', '--standalone',
                   '-t', uuid.uuid4().hex[:22], '-c', str(config)]
        formatted = subprocess.run(storage, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20)
        assert formatted.returncode == 0, formatted.stderr + formatted.stdout
        log = open(root / 'broker.log', 'w+')
        proc = subprocess.Popen(['/opt/kafka/bin/kafka-server-start.sh', str(config)],
                                env=env, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                                start_new_session=True)
        try:
            deadline = time.monotonic() + 35
            admin = AdminClient(dict(auth(bootstrap,'admin') if sasl else {'bootstrap.servers':bootstrap}, **{'socket.timeout.ms':1000}))
            ready = False
            while time.monotonic() < deadline:
                if proc.poll() is not None:
                    break
                try:
                    if admin.list_topics(timeout=1).brokers:
                        ready = True
                        break
                except KafkaException:
                    time.sleep(.2)
            if not ready:
                log.flush(); log.seek(0)
                raise AssertionError('self-started Kafka readiness failed: ' + log.read()[-9000:])
            def restart():
                nonlocal proc
                if proc.poll() is None:
                    os.killpg(proc.pid,signal.SIGTERM)
                    try:proc.wait(timeout=8)
                    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:os.killpg(proc.pid,signal.SIGKILL);proc.wait(timeout=3)
                proc=subprocess.Popen(['/opt/kafka/bin/kafka-server-start.sh',str(config)],env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,start_new_session=True)
                import struct
                deadline=time.monotonic()+30
                while time.monotonic()<deadline:
                    if proc.poll() is not None:break
                    try:
                        host,port_number=bootstrap.split(':')
                        with socket.create_connection((host,int(port_number)),timeout=.5) as channel:
                            payload=struct.pack('>hhih',18,0,42,4)+b'test'
                            channel.sendall(struct.pack('>i',len(payload))+payload)
                            size=channel.recv(4)
                            if len(size)==4:
                                response=channel.recv(struct.unpack('>i',size)[0])
                                if len(response)>=6 and struct.unpack('>i',response[:4])[0]==42:return
                    except OSError:time.sleep(.2)
                raise AssertionError('NATIVE_ENVIRONMENT_ERROR: restart not ready')
            print('NATIVE_KAFKA_READY',flush=True)
            yield {'bootstrap':bootstrap,'config':config,'restart':restart} if expose else bootstrap
        finally:
            if proc.poll() is None:
                os.killpg(proc.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
                try:
                    proc.wait(timeout=8)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                    os.killpg(proc.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
                    proc.wait(timeout=3)
            log.close()


def topic(bootstrap, name, partitions=1, config=None):
    admin = AdminClient({'log_level':0,'bootstrap.servers': bootstrap})
    admin.create_topics([NewTopic(name, partitions, 1, config=config or {})])[name].result(10)


def produce(producer, name, values, partition=0, expected_error=None):
    errors = []
    for value in values:
        producer.produce(name, value, partition=partition,
                         on_delivery=lambda err, message: errors.append(err))
    assert producer.flush(10) == 0
    assert len(errors) == len(values), errors
    if expected_error is None:
        assert all(error is None for error in errors), errors
    else:
        assert all(error and error.code() == expected_error for error in errors), errors


def consumer(bootstrap, group=None, isolation='read_committed'):
    return Consumer({'log_level':0,'bootstrap.servers': bootstrap, 'group.id': group or uuid.uuid4().hex,
                     'enable.auto.commit': False, 'isolation.level': isolation,
                     'enable.partition.eof': True, 'auto.offset.reset': 'earliest',
                     'fetch.wait.max.ms': 50})


def read(bootstrap, name, isolation='read_committed', seconds=2):
    client = consumer(bootstrap, isolation=isolation)
    values = []
    try:
        client.assign([TopicPartition(name, 0, 0)])
        deadline = time.monotonic() + seconds
        while time.monotonic() < deadline:
            message = client.poll(.1)
            if message is not None and not message.error():
                values.append(message.value())
        return values
    finally:
        client.close()


def tx(bootstrap, transaction_id):
    producer = Producer({'log_level':0,'bootstrap.servers': bootstrap, 'transactional.id': transaction_id,
                         'transaction.timeout.ms': 30000, 'message.timeout.ms': 10000})
    producer.init_transactions(15)
    return producer


def auth(bootstrap,user):
    return {'log_level':0,'bootstrap.servers':bootstrap,'security.protocol':'SASL_PLAINTEXT','sasl.mechanism':'PLAIN','sasl.username':user,'sasl.password':user+'-secret','socket.timeout.ms':5000}


def next_message(client,seconds=8):
    deadline=time.monotonic()+seconds
    while time.monotonic()<deadline:
        message=client.poll(.1)
        if message is not None:
            if not message.error():return message
            if message.error().code()!=-191:raise KafkaException(message.error())
    raise AssertionError('expected real Kafka message before deadline')


def committed(bootstrap,name,group,partition=0):
    c=consumer(bootstrap,group)
    try:return c.committed([TopicPartition(name,partition)],timeout=8)[0].offset
    finally:c.close()


def join(client,topic_name,seconds=12):
    client.subscribe([topic_name])
    deadline=time.monotonic()+seconds
    while time.monotonic()<deadline:
        client.poll(.05)
        if client.assignment():return client.assignment()
    raise AssertionError('real group assignment not received')
